messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH error rate for tenant=Ridgeback in eu-west-1 (p95 latency 4.2s, 502 spikes). Alert details: https://pd.example/INC-9523 :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: ack — looking. I'm seeing elevated tail latency on the dedicated pool serving ridgeback-prod-eu. GPU util ~96%, queue depth increasing.

infra-lead: on it with capacity checks. Warm pool in eu-west-2 exists but not attached to ridgeback routing.

eng-runtime: sharing quick metrics: 
- 502s from model shard proxy (k-v cache misses)
- sustained token QPS ~1.8x normal

sre-oncall: customer impact = degraded responses and intermittent 5xx for a subset of paths (streaming generation and long-completion jobs). Putting customer in partial failover plan.

acct-eng: pinged Ridgeback PM via email + slack DM, told them we're initiating controlled regional shift to eu-west-2 warm capacity. They want outbound DNS change first to avoid session loss.

dns-ops: ETA on DNS change window? we can lower TTL and update record. Recommend TTL=60 for cutover.

infra-lead: plan (short):
1) Reduce TTL for ridgeback.rw-inference.com CNAME to 60s (dns-ops)
2) Enable routing rule that splits traffic 80/20 to eu-west-2 warm pool for first 10m (eng-runtime)
3) Monitor 5xx, tail latency, and GPU queue. If stable, shift to 100% over rolling 15m window.
4) If errors spike or warm pool overloaded, rollback to weighted 100% back to eu-west-1 and open emergency lane to dedicated burst.

sre-oncall: executing step 1 now.

dns-ops: lowered TTL to 60s on ridgeback.rw-inference.com (Cloudflare). Change propagated to authoritative; proxied.

sre-oncall: creating weighted routing rule — attaching policy to customer tag ridgeback-tenant.

eng-runtime: applying traffic-split config:
```
# rollout snippet
route update --tenant ridgeback --from-region eu-west-1 --to-region eu-west-2 --weight 20 --strategy gradual --duration 10m
```

eng-runtime: done — 20% traffic to eu-west-2. Monitoring now.

sre-oncall: initial health-checks look OK. 20% keys hitting warm cache in eu-west-2. 502s down by ~60% on split traffic. p95 latency in eu-west-2 ~ 320ms.

cust-success: Ridgeback reports partial improvement on our shared call, appreciated the heads-up. They want to be on the call during 100% switch.

infra-lead: moving to 50% over next 8m.

eng-runtime: updated rollout to 50%.

sre-oncall: monitoring metrics — eu-west-2 GPU queue climbing but still within safe thresholds. No new error patterns.

dns-ops: reminder: we still keep TTL 60 until finalization, then revert to 300 after stabilization.

acct-eng: looping in account exec for post-cutover notes. Ridgeback asked for a post-incident comms template.

eng-runtime: shifting to 100% now (rolling 15m). Command: 
```
route update --tenant ridgeback --weight 100 --duration 15m --drain eu-west-1
```

sre-oncall: 100% traffic in eu-west-2. Monitoring for the next 20m.

infra-lead: during shift we also spun up an extra warm instance group (2x) to handle token load spikes. That was hit but autoscaled fine.

sre-oncall: good signal: overall 5xx down to baseline, p95 back to 360ms. No queued backpressure alerts.

cust-success: Ridgeback confirms all critical flows now green; replication lag for some long-running jobs noted but acceptable. They're keeping a monitor for 2 hours.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call transfer incoming — handoff to next SRE in 30m.

sre-oncall: starting handoff docs in #inc-handoff — adding timeline, commands run, rollback thresholds, contact list.

acct-eng: scheduled postmortem with Ridgeback Tuesday 10:00 UTC; invited eng-runtime and infra.

eng-runtime: adding temporary rule to prefer eu-west-2 for ridgeback until we validate model KV cache behavior across full traffic shape for 48 hours. We'll also run a hot-cache pre-warm job to repopulate keys in eu-west-1 before reversing.

dns-ops: TTL reverted to 300 on ridgeback.rw-inference.com (post-stable).

sre-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep monitoring and update incident ticket.

cust-success: thanks team — Ridgeback PM sends :heart: and asked for runbook additions for future warm failovers.

incident-bot: Incident INC-9523 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled.

sre-oncall: closing thread here; if any regression, re-open or page immediately.
